title: Feature-Action Table
description: A meta-storyboard feature-action table: each row maps a detected feature to one or more visual actions.

feature.description: Feature name: FIRST, CURRENT, LAST, PEAK, VALLEY, MAX, MIN, SLOPE, FALL, RAISE, EVENT, SEGMENTED_EVENT, or a custom name registered via FeatureFactory.register().

properties.description: Numeric conditions filtering the detected features.

action.description: Action name: DOT, CIRCLE, TEXT_BOX, CONNECTOR, or a custom name registered via ActionFactory.register().

properties.description: Action properties; unset fields fall back to per-action defaults. TEXT_BOX title/message support ${variable} templates.
